_comment: Sources for the ai-news skill. Lighter and newsier than research-digest: what shipped, what people are arguing about, what is worth forwarding to a work Slack channel. Run scripts/fetch_news.py --validate after editing feeds.

audience._comment: Curation target. Assume a mixed engineering audience who are interested but not all ML specialists. Interesting and current beats comprehensive.

hackernews._comment: Algolia API, no key. min_points is the noise filter -- below ~80 is mostly undiscussed submissions.

huggingface_models._comment: Trending models. Filtered to models CREATED inside the window, otherwise long-running favorites dominate every run.

huggingface_papers._comment: HF daily papers -- community-upvoted, so it surfaces buzz rather than volume. Complements research-digest's exhaustive arXiv sweep.

github_releases._comment: Atom feed per repo. Concrete 'what shipped' signal. Add repos you actually depend on.

search_only._comment: Sources with no usable API or feed. fetch_news.py does NOT cover these; Claude gathers them with web search per SKILL.md. X and Threads have no free API; The Batch is JS-rendered with no RSS. All of it is lower-fidelity -- label it as such and never let it be the only support for a claim.
